name: Rosetti Marino SpA
summary: Rosetti Marino SpA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the energy, energy transition, and shipbuilding businesses in Italy, the European Union, and internationally. It operates through Oil and Gas; Renewables and Carbon Capture; Shipbuilding; and Sundry Services segments.
